label: OpenCode
description: OpenCode coding agent for Ducky chats, ready out of the box: Ducky installs its own OpenCode, uses your saved API keys or OpenCode's free model, and gives it Ducky's tools. Install from Store → Gateways.

steps.title: Open OpenCode
steps.body: Press the OpenCode row. No key is needed; an OpenCode API key here is optional.

steps.title: OpenCode is ready
steps.body: Nothing to install. Ducky downloads OpenCode on the first message and uses the API keys you saved in Ducky, or OpenCode's free model.

steps.title: Optional: sign in
steps.body: Have a ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or SuperGrok subscription? Log in here and OpenCode uses it.

steps.title: Pick OpenCode in a chat
steps.body: Choose OpenCode in the chat's model picker and send a message.
